title: 第19章 上官无情 怕我吃了你第20章 这老杂役精力居然这么旺盛还来
content_zh:
不仅如此。
女修眼神迷离，吐气如兰，一进门就褪去了身上的纱衣。
和刚才林陌挑选时，看到她那副惊恐、绝望的模样，形成了鲜明对比。
林陌用脚指头都能猜到究竟是怎么回事了。
但这与他无关。
他只是一名普通的消费者，来这里完成自己双修的修炼目的罢了。
在丹药的作用下，女修并不在乎林陌究竟是糟老头子，亦或是帅气的青年。
很主动的开始为林陌服务。
........
深夜，林陌结束了来醉仙楼的第一次消费。
白天身体与精神状况还算良好的女修，此时已经脸色苍白，嘴唇发紫。
整个人看上去似乎都消瘦了不少。
相比之下，林陌反倒是神采奕奕，完全不像是刚激烈运动过的样子。
“居然没有突破...”
穿好衣服，林陌感受了一下体内的灵力。
相比之前是强了不少，但还是未能突破至炼气五重。
不过提升还是很明显的，现在的他距离炼气五重，也仅有一步之遥。
“这是怎么回事？难道是因为老夫境界提升了的原因，还是说...这女的修为太弱了，她的阴气不算强盛？”
林陌暗暗琢磨道。
他觉得，两者的因素都有。

上官无情的修为，肯定是比这名被抓来的女修要强很多的，其体内所蕴含的阴气，自然也要更加旺盛。
“帮帮我，求你...”
蓦地，白华虚弱的声音从背后传来。
白华，自然便是林陌此次双修的女修名字。
过程中，林陌得知了她的名字。
林陌回头，只见白华眼角带泪，一脸恳求地盯着他。
“帮你？怎么帮？”
林陌不解。
白华将她所听到以及看到的事情，详细地给林陌道来。
原来，被抓到醉仙楼的女修，接过客之后就相当于开了刃的剑，不会再进行二次接客了。
她们当中绝大多数人，在事后都会被丢入自修自焚之塔，榨干最后的剩余价值。
白华抓着林陌那干瘦的手臂，哭着哀求道：“我不会怨恨你，我只想活下去，只要...只要你跟他们说，你要把我带回去，就够了。”
content_en:
Not only that.
The female cultivator's eyes were blurred, her breath was like blue, and she took off her gauze as soon as she entered the door.
It was in sharp contrast to the frightened and desperate look Lin Mo saw on her when he was choosing.
Lin Mo could guess what was going on with his toes.
But it has nothing to do with him.
He is just an ordinary consumer who comes here to complete his dual cultivation purpose.
Under the influence of the elixir, the female cultivator didn't care whether Lin Mo was a bad old man or a handsome young man.
He took the initiative and started serving Lin Mo.
........
Late at night, Lin Mo finished his first shopping trip to Zuixian Tower.
The female cultivator, who was in good physical and mental condition during the day, now looked pale and her lips were purple.
The whole person seemed to have lost a lot of weight.
In contrast, Lin Mo was in high spirits, not looking like he had just exercised vigorously.
"There is no breakthrough..."
After putting on his clothes, Lin Mo felt the spiritual power in his body.
It was much stronger than before, but it still failed to break through to the fifth level of Qi refining.
However, the improvement is still obvious. Now he is only one step away from the fifth level of Qi refining.
"What's going on? Is it because I have improved my realm, or... this woman's cultivation is too weak, and her Yin Qi is not strong?"
Lin Mo pondered secretly.
He feels that there are factors of both.
Shangguan Wuqing's cultivation level must be much stronger than that of the captured female cultivator, and the Yin energy contained in her body is naturally stronger.
"Help me, please..."
Suddenly, Bai Hua's weak voice came from behind.
Bai Hua is naturally the name of Lin Mo's female cultivator this time.
During the process, Lin Mo learned her name.
Lin Mo turned around and saw Bai Hua staring at him with tears in his eyes and a pleading look on his face.
"Help you? How?"
Lin Mo was puzzled.
Bai Hua told Lin Mo in detail what she heard and saw.
It turns out that the female cultivator who was caught in Zuixian Tower was like a sharpened sword after taking over the guests and would not pick up the guests again.
Most of them will be thrown into the tower of self-immolation afterwards to squeeze out the last remaining value.
Bai Hua grabbed Lin Mo's thin arm and cried and begged: "I won't resent you. I just want to live. As long as...as long as you tell them that you want to take me back, that's enough."
